celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ﴾ for His Prophet ﷺ against his enemies ﴿وَالْفَتْحُ﴾: the conquest of Mecca,

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ﴾, that is, Islam, ﴿أَفْوَاجًا﴾: in groups, after they used to enter it one by one. That was after the conquest of Mecca, when the Arabs came to him from all regions of the land, obedient.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ﴾, that is, accompanied by His praise, ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا﴾. After the revelation of this sūra he ﷺ used to say often: "Glory be to Allah and with His praise; I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance." From it he knew that his appointed time had drawn near. The conquest of Mecca was in Ramaḍān of the year eight, and he ﷺ died in Rabīʿ al-Awwal of the year ten.
